names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 martie, «Sfânta Muceniță Antonina».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαρτίου, «Αγία Αντωνίνα», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's third heading for 1. март ст. ст., „Света мученица Антонина.“, with Света and the rank word мученица left off. The heading gives no epithet; Nicaea, which the folder's English name carries, is in the body's first sentence. The other Antonina the corpus keeps on this day has no Serbian form, so the fold this would make does not arise.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 1 марта ст. ст., name page 2401, «Мученица Антонина Никейская», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name. The toponymic is part of the name the calendar’s index carries and stays; the day’s line gives the forename alone and in the genitive. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, while the bare «Антонина» is held by `antonina-of-crodamna` and by this folder itself as Serbian forms, and that fold is read in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfânta muceniță Antonina a suferit în Niceea, în timpul unei persecuții sub împăratul Maximian (284-305)» — the page gives the reign and no year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 марта ст. ст. — «Мц. Антонины (III-IV).»

attestations.note: Her life pages on this calendar head themselves «Дни памяти: 1 марта , 13 июня», two days. The day recorded here is the one whose page lists her and which this row cites, 1 марта ст. ст.; the June day is the calendar’s own second commemoration of her and is not a conversion of this one, and it is recorded here as a note because the schema keeps one feast to a church. Nothing was read on days.pravoslavie.ru’s 13 июня.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 martie — «Sfânta Muceniță Antonina»

feast.note: saint.gr's own life page for her closes «Η μνήμη της Αγίας επαναλαμβάνεται την 12η Ιουνίου» — her memory is kept again on 12 June (https://www.saint.gr/3775/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so she renders on 1 March only.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Αγία Αντωνίνα»

attestations.note: The page heads her «Αγια Αντωνινα (; - 304)» and puts her at Nicaea of Bithynia «κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Μαξιμιανού (286 - 305 μ.Χ.)». Its «(; - 304)» is a single year for her death which the corpus's own dates, read off doxologia as a persecution under Maximian, do not carry; the corpus's interval is left as it stands and saint.gr's year is recorded here. The page prints no hymn and names no relic.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.03.2026 (1. март ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Антонина.“

attestations.note: Read onto this folder and not onto `antonina-venerable-martyr-1-march`, the other Antonina the corpus keeps on this menologion day: the Prologue's entry has her born at Nicaea and drowned in a lake in 302, which is this folder's own story and this folder's reign, while the other is a venerable-martyr of 1924.
